title: Crash Bash
_overlays: Code the game loads from the disc. The runtime names these when it misses: it reports the span the disc was read into and the sector it came from, and CRASHBSH.DAT starts at LBA 236, so offset = (sector - 236) * 2048. Addresses decimal, per the schema rule.

overlays._entryHints: Reached through the game's own pointer tables: 0x80092bdc, 0x80092ba0, 0x80092b7c. The next four are addresses the runtime reported missing while the overlay was resident — 0x80084788, 0x8008670c, 0x8008ab48, 0x80093270.

overlays._note: A second block loaded at the same address as `stage` and larger. Crash Bash gives minigames their own code, and they take turns in this one window — which is exactly the case ADR-0006's fingerprinting exists for: same loadAddr, told apart by what is actually in the window. Expect more of these, one per mode; the runtime names each one as it is first reached.
overlays._entryHints: 0x800c3434, which the runtime reported and which reads as a function prologue.

overlays._note: Loaded into the middle of boot's window and displaces it. Two overlays sharing memory is the ordinary case, not an edge one.
overlays._entryHints: 0x800b5244, 0x800b5218, 0x800b51ec, and 0x800b5ac0 which the runtime reported missing.

_functionHints: Entry points nothing calls statically. Six of them are one family: the handler table at 0x80058B00, sixteen bytes a record with the function pointer first, dispatched from 0x8002001c. Reading the whole table at once beat adding its members one cutscene at a time. Others: libcd and the game's own OS layer reach these through pointer tables the analysis cannot read, so the runtime finds them by missing them and they are fed back here. Decimal, per the schema rule; the hex is in notes.md. The eight at 0x8004718c..0x80047218 are the card-event callbacks the game registers with OpenEvent; nothing calls them statically, so they only surface once the events are actually delivered. 0x80030a00 and 0x80030a08 are two more slots of the table at [0x8006794c]: three one-line functions in a row, of which the sweep found only the first.
